description: This Java source file defines the ShardRegionExtractor class, which implements Akka's ShardRegion.MessageExtractor for hash-based sharding in a clustered environment. It manages entity IDs, message processing, shard ID calculation, and inactive shard detection, utilizing mapping strategies for message parsing.

classes.name: ShardRegionExtractor
classes.description: Implements Akka's MessageExtractor for hash-based sharding, handling entity ID extraction, message conversion, shard ID calculation, and inactive shard detection.

methods.description: Creates a ShardRegionExtractor instance using an ActorSystem to load mapping strategies.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ShardRegionExtractor instance with specified mapping strategies.

methods.name: entityId
methods.description: Extracts the entity ID from various message types.

methods.description: Converts messages into Jsonifiable objects if needed, based on message type.

methods.name: shardId
methods.description: Calculates the shard ID based on the entity ID's hash code.

methods.name: getInactiveShardIds
methods.description: Returns a set of shard IDs that are not currently active.

methods.description: Creates a Jsonifiable object from a ShardedMessageEnvelope using mapping strategies.
